text_block_list.text: We did iiit! Yes, we're the beeest!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: All right, all right. Are you going to do that every time we finish a song? Let's get on with the next one already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's. I'm glad both of you are
brimming with motivation. We're
almost
ready for the commemorative concert, so
let's keep up the
pace.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah, Taishin! We have to do our best!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I see the BNW trio are in high spirits! But
the Robot, Rose, and I will
not lose!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
B-Bourbon, are you really okay with being
called a robot?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Classification accepted. "Robot" forms an
alliterative pair with your
"Rose," and is
both brief and identifiable.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: Now, you two, let's go! RRI, hoorah!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
